sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:87500
Court No. - 92
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 11268 of 2024

Applicant :- Madan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Dinesh Kumar Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Rajeev Kumar Singh, learned Aga for the State.

2.  The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire proceedings of Session No.42 of 2019 (State Vs. Madan), arising out of Case Crime No.17 of 2019, under Sections-452, 376,
511 IPC & 7/8 of POCSO Act, Police Station-Baburi, District-Chandauli, pending in the court of Ist Additional Sessions Judge, Chandauli, as well as cognizance order dated 28.06.2019 in terms of compromise dated 12.03.2024.
3.

Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that on the basis of allegation of disrobing the daughter of opposite party, an FIR dated 02.02.2019 was lodged against the applicant,
subsequently, police after investigation has also filed chargesheet dated 25.03.2019.
Though, from the perusal of the statement of the victim girl, it is clear that offence is not in the category of sexual assault.

As both the parties belong to the same village and they have settled their dispute and a written compromise dated 12.03.2024 was also entered into between the parties, a copy of the same has been annexed at page no.34 of the paper book.

4. Considering the aforesaid submission, present application is disposed of with a direction to the applicant to file the original deed of the compromise before the court below, within a period of 15 Madan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198055551/
1 days from today.

entities.text: 15 Madan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case, such compromise is filed, court below will verify the same after summoning the parties and after verification of the aforesaid compromise, court below will permit the parties to obtain certified copy of the same.
Thereafter, parties are at liberty to file a fresh 482 application for quashing the impugned proceeding on the basis of the verified compromise.

5. The aforesaid exercise for verification of the compromise shall be completed by the court below,
within a period of one month.
6. For a period of one month or till passing of the verification order, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.

Order Date :- 15.5.2024 S.Chaurasia  Madan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198055551/
